title: mqtt receipt v1
description: What the host publishes to <prefix>/receipts/<ulid> (QoS 1, RETAINED) for EVERY envelope (fired, refused, failed, unparseable). THICK on purpose: the far end learns the outcome from the receipt alone — status, headers, capped body + full-body digest, latency — plus the X-8-Witness reafference. Retained so a far end that was away still finds its answer. The host's Policy may gate egress (body/headers absent) toward a broker it does not own.

contract.description: trace.Version — the wire contract version the host speaks.

decision.description: The host's verdict. fired=false means the atom never left the host.

policy.description: Which gate decided: validate | expiry | auth-slot | <policy name>.

egress.description: The outbound gate applied to this receipt (absent = full: capped body + headers).

call.description: Echo of a fired CALL. Headers are deliberately absent — after auth_slot resolution they hold a credential.

channel.description: Echo of a fired CHANNEL command.

status.description: HTTP status of the afferent leg at the witness (the command's own result is in body).

body_len.description: Full body length before the cap.

body_digest.description: sha256 hex of the FULL body.

body.description: Capped at the host's max-body; absent when egress.body=false.

headers.description: Response headers, first value each; absent when egress.headers=false.

witness.description: The reafference the 8 collector stamped on the response, verbatim.

node.description: The host's node name (its MQTT client id).

route.description: How the receipt itself travelled — the app-routing knobs made visible.
